releases.new: Resize images with the new Magic Kernel Sharp resampling modes, and pass a strip_namespaces argument to getxmp() to control XMP namespace handling.
releases.breaking: Python 3.10 is no longer supported, ExifTags.IFD.Makernote and GifImagePlugin._save_netpbm are removed, and XMP info is no longer a tuple; upgrade Python and adjust code using these.

releases.new: Open and save L mode AVIF images with libavif 1.3.0 or newer, and use Pillow on Python 3.15 with new beta wheels.
releases.breaking: Non-image ImageCms modes were removed, ImageCms now errors on mode mismatches, and macOS retina screenshots are no longer resized by default; adjust code relying on these.

releases.new: Wrap text with the new ImageText.Text.wrap() method, and convert font files to usable fonts with FontFile.to_imagefont().
releases.breaking: Encoding an empty image now raises ValueError instead of the previous error; update any code that catches the old exception type when saving empty images.

releases.new: Use the new get_flattened_data() method in place of getdata(), save APNG animations with float durations, and pass a window ID to ImageGrab.grab() on macOS.
